title: Samsung Electronics
summary: Samsung is the world's largest memory provider and the only logic foundry capable of rivaling TSMC at the leading edge (3nm/2nm). Their transition to Gate-All-Around (GAA) is a critical milestone.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Samsung is the world's largest memory provider and the only logic foundry capable of rivaling TSMC at the leading edge (3nm/2nm). Their transition to Gate-All-Around (GAA) is a critical milestone.
